blockingFindings.description: Directly inspected current five-view and six-pose renders. V121 now shows the ivory jacket front extending from collar to waistband in the neutral front view, but body-color breast surfaces still protrude through the bodice and the three-quarter and side views show broken/pinched torso transitions. Surface coverage improved, but the jacket is not visually fitted.
The current back view still shows broad faceted/folded shading over the posterior shoulder and upper back; the torso surface remains visibly uneven.
The outfit remains almost entirely white with a narrow lilac diagonal chest strip and sparse piping. Metallic lamé response and fencing-practice details are not visually legible.

Current sit and crouch poses show skirt/shorts lift and thigh intersections; prone still presents a broad disk-like skirt flare. Final fit, deform weights, Shape Key response, Unity/VRChat execution, and release packaging remain unverified.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
